Implementation of Khelo India Scheme 
  
†747. DR. DHAL SINGH BISEN: 
  
Will the Minister of YOUTH AFFAIRS AND SPORTS be pleased to state: 
  
(a) whether the Government is implementing Khelo India Scheme;  
 
(b) if so, the time of beginning of the said scheme; 
 
(c) the steps taken by the Government for sports competition and 
infrastructure development under the said Scheme; 
 
(d) whether the Government has received any proposal for construction of 
sports complex of Major Dhyan Chand Hockey Stadium, Seoni Balaghat 
Parliamentary Constituency under this Scheme; 
 
(e) if so, the details thereof; 
 
(f) whether the Government will approve the proposal for construction of 
sports complex in Seoni under the Khelo India Scheme; and  
 
(g) if so, the time by which it is likely to be approved and if not the reasons 
therefor?  
 
ANSWER 
THE MINISTER OF YOUTH AFFAIRS & SPORTS  
{SHRI ANURAG SINGH THAKUR} 
 
(a) and (b) Yes, Sir. With a view to achieving the twin objectives of mass 
participation and promotion of excellence in sports, the Government 
introduced the Scheme of “Khelo India – National Programme for 
Development of Sports” in 2016-17.  
 
(c) Khelo India Youth Games, Khelo India University Games, Khelo India 
Winter Games, Khelo India Women leagues in various sports disciplines 

Page 2 of 2 
such as Archery, Basketball, Boxing, Cycling, Football, Hock ey, Swimming, 
Volleyball, Wrestling, etc. have been cond ucted as part of these games . A 
total of 297 sports infrastructure projects have been sanctioned across the 
country since the inception of the Scheme. 
 
(d) to (g) Yes, Sir. Under the Khelo India Scheme, one proposal for 
Construction of Sports Complex at Ma jor Dhyan Chand Hockey Stadium, 
Seoni, Madhya Pradesh at an estimated cost of ₹ 9.97 crore has been 
received in this Ministry.  The proposals are apprais ed and approved in the 
Ministry on the basis of technical feasibility, adherence to the prescribed 
parameters as well as the availability of funds under the Scheme.

GOVERNMENT OF INDIA 
MINISTRY OF INFORMATION AND BROADCASTING 
 
LOK SABHA 
UNSTARRED  QUESTION  NO. 748 
TO BE ANSWERED ON 07-02-2023 
 
 
CENSORSHIP TO FAKE NEWS 
 
748. SHRI VIJAYAKUMAR ALIAS VIJAY VASANTH: 
 
Will the Minister of INFORMATION AND BROADCASTING be pleased to state: 
(a) whether the Government proposes to police fake news akin to censorship; 
(b) if so, the details thereof; 
(c) whether the Government itself decides fake or false news concept without 
enquiry; and 
(d) if so, the details thereof including the manner in which it is being decided and 
the reasons therefor? 
 
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF INFORMATION AND BROADCASTING; AND  
MINISTER OF YOUTH AFFAIRS AND SPORTS 
(SHRI ANURAG SINGH THAKUR) 
 
(a) to (d)  A Fact Check Unit was setup under Press Information 
Bureau of this Ministry in November, 2019, takes cognizance of fake 
news relating to Central Government both suo-motu and by way of 
queries sent by citizens and responds to the relevant queries with 
correct information. The content or information of such 
claims/news/facts is decided as fake news, after due verification, 
and posted on social media handles of PIB. 
         The PIB also maintains a twitter account @PIBFactcheck and 
posts cases of fake news, being busted, on the same on regular 
basis. PIB Fact Check Unit has a Website Portal- 
https://factcheck.pib.gov.in/ for reporting of fake news and for fact-
checking of information by the citizens.

GOVERNMENT OF INDIA 
MINISTRY OF AGRICULTURE AND FARMERS WELFARE 
DEPARTMENT OF AGRICULTURE AND FARMERS WELFARE 
 
LOK SABHA 
UNSTARRED QUESTION NO. 749 
TO BE ANSWERED ON 7TH FEBRUARY, 2023 
 
PM-KISAN PAYMENTS 
 
749. DR. SHASHI THAROOR: 
 
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE AND FARMERS WELFARE क ृ षि एवं ककसान  कल्याण मंत्री 
be pleased to state: 
 
(a)  whether it is correct that the payments made to beneficiaries under Prime Minister’s 
Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM -Kisan) has fallen by 67% in the 11 th instalment disbursed in 
October 2022; 
 
(b)  if so, the reasons therefor; 
 
(c)  whether the Government has undertaken any steps to increase the number of 
beneficiaries receiving payments under PM-Kisan; and 
 
(d)  if so, the details thereof? 
 
ANSWER 
 
MINISTER OF AGRICULTURE AND FARMERS WELFARE  
क ृ षि एवं ककसान  कल्याण मंत्री (SHRI NARENDRA SINGH TOMAR) 
 
(a): The number of beneficiaries under Prime Minister’s  Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM -Kisan) 
has increased from 3.16 crore in the 1 st period (December 2018 – March 2019) to 10.45 
crore in the 11th period(April 2022 – July 2022). 
 
(b): Does not arise. 
 
(c) & (d): The Government has undertaken the following steps to increase the number of 
beneficiaries receiving payments under PM-Kisan:- 
 
(i)  A special facility has been provided to the farmers in the PM -KISAN Portal, 
namely Farmers Corner.  Through this facility, farmers can do their self -
registration  

(ii) A special mobile App has been launched on 24 th February 2020.  The App  
provides the facilities available through Farmers Corner. 
(iii) Common Service Centres have been authorized to assist the farmers in 
registration for the PM -KISAN Scheme, updation of their data and in 
ascertaining the status of processing of their payment.   
(iv) State Governments have appointed nodal officers for the scheme at Block, 
District and State Level.   
(v) The States/UTs have organized publicity/ awareness camps to ensure 
expeditious verification of the data of the registered beneficiaries.   
(vi) States/UTs have been asked to expedite the process of saturation of the  
Scheme by ensuring enrollment of all eligible farmer families.
